signals.text: Auralis Bench Calibrator was launched.

Workshop correction: The Object is the stated physical weight of the woven strap supplied with Auralis Bench Calibrator. I retract the assertion about this Object. My correction concerns the strap's weight.
Auralis Bench Calibrator was launched.

Workshop correction: The Object is the stated physical weight of the woven strap supplied with Auralis Bench Calibrator. I retract the assertion about this Object. I also deny the claim that Auralis Bench Calibrator was launched.

Subject: postal-code lettering printed on the Boreal Kite Recorder return card
I withdraw the statement about that Subject. The disputed matter is the lettering of the postal code on the card.
Boreal Kite Recorder was launched.
Subject: a launch assertion quoted on the Boreal Kite Recorder return card
I withdraw the statement about that Subject. The card does not name the product owner of the launch assertion, and none is supplied here.
